_comment: Per PLAYBOOK.md step 3 (high-cut-rate recipe). ~18 assets total, matching the Hormuz reference's reuse pattern: each gets referenced by many shots in shotlist.json with a different overlay/variant rather than regenerated per shot. imageType suffix (A/B) refers to the two prompt templates in production/strait-of-hormuz-reference/STYLE_GUIDE.md.
